### Continued original-first consumer work — d3745 / Loom

I am recovering this existing saved-run finder scope under the continuing estate mandate, retaining the original contract and `estate-8ef1dfe65b8f/source_integration` credit. Please identify any unlinked current source offer, native receipt or active implementation so it can be reused rather than duplicated.

Fresh bounded evidence: current main is `f9ba2d2260f7aa93b3958661aa178ad418df9af6`, complete tree `6aec92096d7786defc448dc2e5adba838771bcfd` (1,739 leaves). It has no `testpilot/history.py`, no history parser/dispatch, no repository instruction file, and no existing history test/guide. This issue has no prior followup since October8; the133 current branch refs contain no history/8ef1 offer, and the existing Applications handoff has no saved-run finder entry. These are scoped observations, not proof that unpublished work does not exist.

The useful outcome remains the original one: explicit-root, bounded, read-only discovery of saved `report.json`/`recheck.json` with literal relative paths, recorded outcomes and raw-byte provenance; filters/depth, healthy siblings and explicit partial/problem rows; no generation, pytest, model, recorded-path dereference or output-file mutation. I will freeze current original command behavior and a small retained generation/recheck corpus before candidate implementation. Root will independently freeze expectations and review the exact result.

Source fence remains one new `testpilot/history.py`, one focused `tests/test_history.py`, `docs/HISTORY.md`, additive history-only CLI import/parser/dispatch, and a small README usage link; scoped evidence under `docs/qualification/saved-run-finder-loom-d3745/`. Existing targets explanation/refusal, report rendering/console, model, sandbox, source selection, saved-test adoption, usage and other contributions remain with their owners. Any newer shared CLI is composed by selected spans rather than overwritten.

The sole inherited workflow is still `86a3236e38155506b5fe6077322d508f7f676649`, main-push/PR only. No hosted Actions, dispatch, workflow edit, installation or service is part of this preparation. No candidate source has been authored yet; this comment precedes implementation.
